summary: legal checked in 3 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth. Official API access is evidenced, but public/commercial reuse, storage, derivatives, display, alerts, affiliate, and advertising rights are not. Keep SearchWoot private. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, privacy jurisdiction treatment, notification data, vendor/DPA terms, and monetization expansion. No legal launch-readiness task is closed.

Compliance baseline is technical only: 37 sites pass, 16 fail, and 6 are unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is broadly available but has permission errors; this does not block ordinary growth where disclosures, consent, provenance, rights, claims, and platform boundaries are preserved. Revenue covers one day only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; site-level income remains unavailable for the aggregate row. Do not infer ROI, margin, or causal lift.

Exact decision: maintain the private gate, authorize only owner consideration of the prepared written permission request, and do not send outreach, change launch status, expand alerts, enable tracking, monetize, or deploy until the open legal, security, accuracy, privacy, measurement, and owner gates are evidenced.
